name: Daniel Okonkwo
oneLine: Senior backend engineer, about 14 years in (defense, payments, HR SaaS), back after two years caring for his dad and aiming for senior or staff backend work on payments and ledger infrastructure, remote or Atlanta.

stories.title: Time off to care for my dad (and open source)

companies.name: Brickyard Pay
companies.why: Payments and ledgers are the whole business there, which is exactly the work I loved at Tallyline.

companies.name: Cartwheel Commerce
companies.why: Big payments and platform problems, remote by default, and they take writing and developer tooling seriously.

companies.name: Saltbox
companies.why: Restaurant payments plus payroll and scheduling, which is basically Tallyline and Shiftwell in one company.

companies.name: Edgewarden
companies.why: Developer infrastructure at real scale; rate limiting is the kind of problem I built tollgate to understand.

companies.name: Kestrel Ridge Federal
companies.why: A recruiter keeps reaching out; it's payments work in Alpharetta and pays fine, but it's cleared federal work, so probably not.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer, Ledger Platform
postings.why: Double-entry ledger, migrations, idempotency and reconciliation are his core record; remote US, base $192k-$288k, travel under 5%, no clearance.

postings.title: Staff Platform Engineer, Core Services
postings.why: Monolith-to-services extraction and rate limiting match Shiftwell and tollgate; IC staff role, remote US, base $213k-$266k, travel under 10%.

postings.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Disbursement Systems (TS/SCI)
postings.why: Requires an active TS/SCI clearance on day one; his Secret clearance lapsed and he won't take roles needing an active clearance (pay and Atlanta-area hybrid would otherwise pass).
